stories.summary: Apple reported record September-quarter revenue of $114.5 billion (up 12%) but guided holiday gross margins to 45–46%, below the Street's 46.3%, as memory chip costs surge. It raised device prices, lifted purchase commitments by $33 billion, and saw inventory climb 154% to $14.5 billion, while Oppenheimer warned iPhone growth is slowing.
